theory.intro: Fixture: a rectangular prism HAND-PROJECTED into plain 2D coordinates with no tdplot at all — the house 3D convention used by the shipped `trigonometry-3d` and by W3-11's `solve-3d-trig`. The depth edges all carry the same oblique offset (2.0, 1.2) and are therefore deliberately foreshortened, so comparing drawn 2D lengths against the in-plane median would wrongly flag the labelled depth edge. The audit must recognise the repeated oblique offset and SKIP the figure.
